target: acceptance 6 — LOOP_POLICY must carry ONE rule covering tool output, error output and external-model output as data rather than instructions
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/templates/LOOP_POLICY.md"; blk=$(grep -A6 -i "never instructions\|data, not instructions\|is data, never" "$f" | tr "\n" " "); tool=$(printf "%s" "$blk"|grep -ci "tool"); err=$(printf "%s" "$blk"|grep -ci "error\|stack trace"); ext=$(printf "%s" "$blk"|grep -ci "model"); printf '{"tool":%s,"err":%s,"ext":%s}' "$tool" "$err" "$ext"
